name: Rapid Reweaving
body:
Your rewoven spells recover more quickly than usual.

Prerequisites: Rapid Recovery, reweave spell class feature.

Benefit: You can apply the Rapid Recovery feat to major rewoven spells as if they were the spirit’s major granted ability. Like Rapid Recovery this feat does not reduce the number of rounds a rewoven spell is expended for if it is expended by means other than using it.

Normal: You cannot reduce the number of rounds that a rewoven spell is expended for.
